Name: KhaStark Extra Cats
Author: KhaStark
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS]KhaStark Extra Cats adds 11 additional cat breeds based on edited vanilla Stardew Valley cat sprites.

The cats are added as separate breeds instead of replacing the vanilla cat choices. All 11 are enabled by default, but each breed has its own on/off option so you can keep only the designs you want.

When a breed is disabled, it is hidden from character creation and Marnie's pet adoption options. Its breed data stays registered, so changing the setting will not invalidate a cat you already adopted.

[list=1]

[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Install SMAPI.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Install Content Patcher.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Optional: install Generic Mod Config Menu if you want to change the cat selection in-game.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Download KhaStark Extra Cats and extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]If you previously installed a test, personal, or older public build of KhaStark Extra Cats, remove that older copy first. Do not keep duplicate versions installed together.[/font][/*]
